newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates lower in liquid market.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates lower in liquid market.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) slightly mellowed in almost all maturities because of expectations of lower interest rates, traders said on Monday.
Only the one-year rate was unchanged.

Late last week, the Central Bank announced it was going to cut reserve requirements by two percentage points next year, which is estimated to result in an additional 54.8 billion pesos to total domestic liquidity and lower interest rates.
A dealer said banks also had to adjust their swap rates some more because of the very liquid market.
"They don't want to be swamped with more pesos," a dealer said.
PHIBOR represents rates banks would be willing to swap their pesos for dollars.
